title: MedNeRF
paper_title: MedNeRF: Medical Neural Radiance Fields for Reconstructing 3D-Aware CT-Projections from a Single X-Ray
core_mech: MedNeRF 把 NeRF 置于 GAN 式跨病例生成先验中，以 shape/appearance latent 从单 X-ray 合成视角，而非逐场景多视图优化。
core_mech_en: Adapts GIRAFFE/GRAF 3D-aware generative radiance fields to X-ray projections, disentangling 3D shape and appearance latents to synthesize continuous-angle CT projections from a single X-ray.
input_desc: 训练时为未配对的 2D X-ray 与采样相机位姿；推理时以单张 X-ray 约束患者潜变量
input_en: Unpaired 2D DRR/X-ray projections during GAN training; a single 2D X-ray during test-time latent inversion
output_desc: 视角可控的 3D-aware CT projection 合成
output_en: Continuous-angle 3D-aware X-ray projection synthesis across 360° viewpoints
gaps: MedNeRF requires its radiance-field adversarial training and original conditioning pipeline. The generic NeRF mechanism demo is not renamed as MedNeRF.
